release_summary: Six-module workspace; annotated review with visual error marking on creatives and text; reviewer decisions; correction editor; original vs corrected comparison; Impact Monitor; Inkloom AI demo company. Public landing page unchanged. Follow-up releases: evaluator guidance (role guide, six-step walkthrough with progress, More to explore, try-this sample files, AI retry, rule templates); guided auto-play landing tour via Watch the crew work and ?tour=1; live AI on by default in demos with graceful daily-limit handling.

verification.local_browser: desktop 1440px and mobile 375px: demo entry on the marked ad, mark selection with connector, reviewer confirm with logged reason, apply all fixes, save and re-check clean, request review, independent approval with receipt, original vs corrected, Impact Monitor 14 to 7 days with reassessment queue, stale-check re-check, paste-text dynamic scan, Company Hub, Trust & Audit; no horizontal overflow on mobile
verification.production_api_flow: passed: fresh Inkloom demo with six findings; author decision refused (403); reviewer confirm (200); contradiction rejection refused (409); corrected version re-checked with zero findings; self-approval refused (403); reviewer approval (200) with SHA-256 receipt; impact preview 4 items; fact change flagged linked content for reassessment
verification.production_live_ai: passed: Gemini OCR re-read the sample image into 10 regions, read the hand-drawn rupee sign correctly, independently returned logo result 'modified', and the rule engine reproduced all six findings. The separate semantic text call returned a provider HTTP 503 and was reported as 'AI incomplete', which blocks approval until a re-check, as designed.
verification.landing_tour: local: ?tour=1 waits for the intro, starts at the top and reaches the final call to action in about 46 s at 1440x900; wheel input stops it; embedded button tour ends on Explore demo with a pulse. production: ?tour=1 auto-scrolls as expected.
verification.ai_default: Demo workspaces start with ai_enabled when a provider is configured; seeded scans stay rule-only so entry makes no provider call; reached daily limits return rule checks marked AI incomplete.

owner_next_step: Existing owners sign in normally. Judges choose Explore demo.
limits: Functional release verification; no penetration test, large-scale load certification or user study is claimed.
